top_signals.title: September Jobs Miss Shocks Markets
top_signals.summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." A big jobs miss rattles markets as credit investors turn cautious. Blackstone joins Broadcom’s massive AI financing push, while Anthropic eyes an IPO. Michael McKee breaks down factory orders and the G7 oil release. Plus Kevin Hassett, Edward Jones CEO Penny Pennington, and Snap-on’s CEO on jobs, investing, tariffs and US manufacturing. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bond Yields Are 'Juicy,' Says Apollo's Slok
top_signals.summary: Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo, joins Scarlet Fu an Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." He says the yields you can get now in fixed income are "juicy." (Source: Bloomberg)
